mapper.sql: cm.id, cm.recipe_id, cm.user_id, cm.parent_id, cm.root_id, cm.reply_user_id, cm.content, cm.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, ru.nickname AS reply_nickname
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `comment` (recipe_id, user_id, parent_id, root_id, reply_user_id, content) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{rootId}, #{replyUserId}, #{content})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM `comment` cm JOIN `user` u ON cm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `user` ru ON cm.reply_user_id = ru.id WHERE cm.id = #{id}

SELECT cm.id, cm.recipe_id, cm.user_id, cm.parent_id, cm.root_id, cm.reply_user_id, cm.content, cm.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM `comment` cm JOIN `user` u ON cm.user_id = u.id WHERE cm.recipe_id = #{recipeId} AND cm.parent_id = 0 ORDER BY cm.id ASC

SELECT
FROM `comment` cm JOIN `user` u ON cm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `user` ru ON cm.reply_user_id = ru.id WHERE cm.root_id IN #{rid} ORDER BY cm.id ASC

SELECT cm.id, cm.recipe_id, cm.user_id, cm.parent_id, cm.root_id, cm.reply_user_id, cm.content, cm.create_time, r.title AS recipe_title FROM `comment` cm JOIN recipe r ON cm.recipe_id = r.id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cm.id DESC

SELECT cm.id, cm.recipe_id, cm.user_id, cm.parent_id, cm.root_id, cm.reply_user_id, cm.content, cm.create_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, r.title AS recipe_title FROM `comment` cm JOIN `user` u ON cm.user_id = u.id JOIN recipe r ON cm.recipe_id = r.id
(cm.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY cm.id DESC
